name: COMP_026
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (93%)** · Confident · Read in turn
- Tier-1 unflagged surgical frozen section [F1] with suggested tumor at superior, medial, and lateral margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 93%, InSitu 6%, Normal 1%, Benign 0% (test ECE 5%, n=132) | Strong invasive score; small-set calibration |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 10% alpha (90% test coverage, CI 76–98%, n=132) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 98%, OOD 88th percentile, 12/12 regions kept, unflagged [F6] (error AUROC 0.70) | Typical image quality; unflagged input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class (true) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (83–87% similarity); 1/5 InSitu (BACH_0124, 83%) [F5] | Mostly invasive; close InSitu neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 5, 7) · context · Above typical; negative weight (-1.42) lowers invasive score [F2] (8/20 AI-checked) · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive driver (+1.04) in top-row high-risk regions [F3] (19/20 AI-checked) · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable negative score (-0.86; 0/20 AI-checked) in low-risk bottom row [F4] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 5, 7) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable weak score (+0.63; 0/20 AI-checked) pushing toward invasive · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 4, 5, 7) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable positive score (+0.32; 3/20 AI-checked) in middle row · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing 3 top-risk regions drops risk beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion diff +0.001, CI -0.009 to 0.006); leans on unreliable `normal_lobules` (0/20), `mitoses` (0/20), `necrosis` (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 0–3 are actually in-situ carcinoma (like 83%-similar `BACH_0124`), separated by weak `duct_confined` and unreliable `mitoses`.
- Simulated composite frozen-section traits (88th OOD percentile, IHC stains blocked) mimic stromal invasion or positive surgical margins.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 3**: Verify true stromal invasion versus in-situ carcinoma along the 860 um superior margin.
2. **Regions 0, 3, 4, 7**: Confirm tumor involvement at the medial (323 um) and lateral (323 um) margins.
3. **Regions 4, 5, 7**: Check whether dense lymphocytes obscure duct boundaries where frozen-section IHC stains are blocked.
